class.name: com.simplysoftware.OshiMonitor.OshiMonitor
class.comment: OshiMonitor library for B4J. Uses the OSHI library to monitor CPU, RAM, and Temperature.

method.name: Start
method.comment: Starts the background monitoring thread. Raises Updated, CpuUsage, CpuTemp and RamUsage events at the configured interval.

method.name: Stop
method.comment: Stops the monitoring thread. The object remains initialized and can be restarted with Start.

method.name: GetSystemUptimeSeconds
method.comment: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

method.name: GetDisplays
method.comment: Returns a list containing information about connected displays.

method.name: GetProcessorLoad
method.comment: Returns an array of CPU load percentages for each individual logical processor.

method.name: GetMostActiveInterfaceIndex
method.comment: Returns the index of the network interface with the highest combined Traffic (received + sent) since system boot.

method.name: ResetProcessMaximums
method.comment: Resets the tracked maximum CPU and RAM values for the target process to zero.

method.name: GetSoundCards
method.comment: Returns a list containing the names of active sound cards or audio interfaces.

method.name: GetNetworkInterfaceNames
method.comment: Returns a list of names of all network interfaces.

method.name: GetSwapTotal
method.comment: Returns the total swap file size in bytes.

method.name: IsInitialized
method.comment: Returns true if the object has been initialized and not yet killed.

method.name: GetNetworkIPv6Addresses
method.comment: Returns a list containing the IPv6 addresses for each active network interface.

method.name: GetProcessDetails
method.comment: Returns a map containing detailed information about a specific process by its name.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initializes the monitor and prepares OSHI hardware access.

method.name: GetGraphicsCards
method.comment: Returns a List containing the name and video memory size of each graphics card.

method.name: GetSwapUsed
method.comment: Returns the currently used swap file size in bytes.

method.name: GetTotalBytesForInterface
method.comment: Returns the total bytes (received + sent) for a specific network interface.

method.name: GetVirtualMemoryUsed
method.comment: Returns the currently used virtual memory in bytes.

method.name: GetMotherboardModel
method.comment: Returns the motherboard or baseboard model name.

method.name: GetOSBuild
method.comment: Returns the exact build number of the current operating system.

method.name: GetTotalBytesRead
method.comment: Returns total bytes read across all disks since system boot.

method.name: GetTotalBytesSent
method.comment: Returns the number of bytes sent across all network interfaces.

method.name: GetUsbDevices
method.comment: Returns a list containing the names of connected USB devices.

method.name: GetNetworkInErrors
method.comment: Returns the number of inbound errors for a specific interface index.

method.name: GetBiosVersion
method.comment: Returns the system BIOS or firmware version string.

method.name: IsLaptopByBattery
method.comment: Returns true if the system appears to be a laptop based on battery presence.

method.name: GetLogicalProcessorCount
method.comment: Returns the total number of logical processors (threads).

method.name: GetProcessorName
method.comment: Returns the processor name from the system.

method.name: GetRefreshRate
method.comment: Returns the current refresh rate of the primary display in Hz. Returns 0 if the refresh rate is unknown or cannot be determined.

method.name: GetBatteryCurrentCapacity
method.comment: Returns the current battery capacity in mAh.

method.name: GetCurrentPowerWatts
method.comment: Returns the current power usage in watts as reported by the battery controller. Note: When plugged in, this reflects the charge rate; when on battery, this reflects the total system power draw.

method.name: GetSystemModel
method.comment: Returns the physical computer system model name.

method.name: GetBatteryDesignCapacity
method.comment: Returns the battery design capacity in mAh.

method.name: GetPhysicalCoreCount
method.comment: Returns the number of physical CPU cores.

method.name: ListProcesses
method.comment: Returns a List of unique running process names, sorted A-Z.

method.name: GetBatteryCharging
method.comment: Returns true if the battery is currently charging, false otherwise.

method.name: GetSystemUptimeMinutes
method.comment: Returns the system uptime in minutes.

method.name: GetFanSpeeds
method.comment: Returns an array containing the current speed of each system fan in RPM.

method.name: GetTrackedPeakMemory
method.comment: Returns the highest combined resident set size (physical memory) used by all instances of a specific process name since the application started monitoring.

method.name: GetVirtualMemoryTotal
method.comment: Returns the total virtual memory in bytes.

method.name: GetTotalBytesReceived
method.comment: Returns the number of bytes received across all network interfaces.

method.name: GetSystemUptimeHours
method.comment: Returns the system uptime in hours.

method.name: ResetMaximums
method.comment: Resets the tracked maximum CPU and RAM values for the system to zero.

method.name: Kill
method.comment: Kills the ba object reference to free memory and stops the thread cleanly. After calling this, IsInitialized will return false.

method.name: GetDriveLatency
method.comment: Returns the average I/O latency in milliseconds for a specific drive index. Latency = (Total Time Spent / Total Operations)

method.name: GetNetworkInDrops
method.comment: Returns the number of inbound packets dropped for a specific interface index.

method.name: GetCpuVoltage
method.comment: Returns the current CPU voltage in volts.

method.name: GetOSName
method.comment: Returns the full family and description name of the operating system.

method.name: GetProcessPeakMemory
method.comment: Returns the peak resident set size (physical memory) used by a process in bytes.

method.name: GetBatteryWatts
method.comment: Returns the current power usage in watts as reported by the battery controller. Note: When plugged in, this reflects the charge rate; when on battery, this reflects the total system power draw.

method.name: GetNetworkOutErrors
method.comment: Returns the number of outbound errors for a specific interface index.

method.name: HasCpuTemp
method.comment: Returns true if CPU temperature monitoring is supported.

method.name: IsCharging
method.comment: Checks if the primary battery is currently charging. Return true if charging, false otherwise.

method.name: GetNetworkIPv4Addresses
method.comment: Returns a list containing the IPv4 addresses for each active network interface.

method.name: GetInterfaceTrafficSpeed
method.comment: Returns a custom result object (or array) with current traffic speeds in Bytes per second for a specific interface.

method.name: GetLogicalDrives
method.comment: Returns a list containing space and mount point information for logical drives.

method.name: GetTotalBytesWritten
method.comment: Returns total bytes written across all disks since system boot.

property.name: IntervalMs
property.comment: Sets the update interval in milliseconds. Values lower than 100ms are clamped to 100ms.

property.name: RamTotalMB
property.comment: Returns total physical memory in megabytes.

property.name: MaxProcessRamUsage
property.comment: Returns the highest Process RAM usage percentage recorded.

property.name: RamUsage
property.comment: Returns RAM usage as a percentage.

property.name: ProcessCpuUsage
property.comment: Returns CPU usage for the configured target process as a percentage.

property.name: CpuUsage
property.comment: Returns CPU usage as a percentage.

property.name: MaxRamUsageMB
property.comment: Returns the highest RAM usage in megabytes recorded since start or reset.

property.name: TargetProcessName
property.comment: Returns the current target process name. Returns an empty string if no process is configured.

property.name: MaxRamUsage
property.comment: Returns the highest RAM usage percentage recorded since start or reset.

property.name: MaxProcessRamUsageMB
property.comment: Returns the highest Process RAM usage in megabytes recorded.

property.name: RamTotal
property.comment: Returns total physical memory in bytes.

property.name: MaxCpuUsage
property.comment: Returns the highest CPU usage recorded since start or reset.

property.name: PowerUsageWatts
property.comment: Gets the current power usage in watts. Return Watts being used or supplied.

property.name: MaxProcessCpuUsage
property.comment: Returns the highest Process CPU usage recorded since the process was targeted or reset.

property.name: RamTotalGB
property.comment: Returns total physical memory in gigabytes.

property.name: ProcessRamUsage
property.comment: Returns RAM usage for the configured target process as a percentage of total system RAM.

property.name: ProcessRamUsageMB
property.comment: Returns RAM usage for the configured target process in megabytes.

field.name: Debug
field.comment: Enables diagnostic logging. When true internal debug messages are written to the B4J log.
